description: Check readiness for creative brief generation or editing. Briefs are generated from a Study revision: pass studyContext to check that revision (its studyRef, revision and video count); without one the outcome asks for a Study (socialseal_start_study). This check does not gate unrelated reads, account metrics or Studies. Reads stored evidence/configuration; no provider collection or collection charge. Preserve returned timestamps, coverage, missing evidence and errors. Synchronous; no polling unless the result explicitly supplies continuation.
